method: Reuse saved project backtests only. No simulations, strategy edits or parameter selection. ETH: each pair has identical parameters except one factor; rank median absolute return difference across 64 pairs. BTC: change only one factor around the named configuration, rank max-minus-min return over 3 pretested values in 2022-09-10 through 2024-09-10. Importance depends on tested ranges, configuration and period; no full-factor ranking is supported for the final BTC two years. Returns are percentage points, zero fees/slippage, full-equity compounding.
